title: 第23章 为了骑士的荣誉决斗第24章 今天有约会感谢盟主帅的不要不要的12138
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
摆在洗手台上的，是堂吉诃德有些脏兮兮的刮胡刀，刀片上面甚至还有焦黄色的水垢和锈迹。
显然，堂吉诃德这种长袖改短袖，短袖改内裤的人是不会舍得花钱去买替换的刀片的。
但是就算是锈了一部分的刀片，也能轻易地划开粗糙的脸部，造成出血。
李维拿过刮胡刀，拆下了刀片，然后往自己的手臂上轻轻一滑。
一股坚韧的感觉从刀片上传来，就好像刀片划过的不是人体，而是某种比刀片强度更高的物质，就像是钢缆一样。
李维刚开始还是轻轻地划了划，到后面他稍微加大了一些力量，但是依旧只能在他的小臂上划出一道道浅浅的白印。
不过李维感觉目前这似乎就是极限了，只要再锋利一些、力量再大一些，似乎还是可以对他造成微量的伤害。
“不过这似乎只是青铜级别的躯体，”李维突然想起了自己读的课外读物里面的神话设定，“后面是不是还有白银、黄金之躯这种更高级别的东西？”
就在他转身的时候，不小心碰倒了洗手台上立着的刮胡刀和牙刷。
然而就在他碰倒的那一刹那，他就迅速地反应了过来，一手一个接住了刚刚摔下洗手台的刮胡刀和牙刷。
“这就是1.4的敏捷和1.5的精神吗？”李维惊讶地看着手上的两件东西，“敏捷一下子提升了0.2，连带着我的神经反应速度都提升了。”
把刮胡刀片重新装了回去，李维已经有些期待明天早上去健身房能拿到什么样的结果了。
...
第二天堂吉诃德照常早早醒来，心事重重地出了门。
李维今天则是稍微改动了一下自己的日程，把上午的兼职挪到了下午，跟迈克尔约好了，今天一起来健身房健身。
10点15分左右，等到李维已经完成了功课来到了健身房的时候，他有些惊讶地发现今天健身房的人比往常多了不少，前台空无一人，而迈克尔正挤在外围朝中间张望。
他走上前去拍了拍迈克尔的肩膀。
“什么情况？”他指了指中间，“今天人怎么这么多？”
“哦......李维你来了，今天有活动，”迈克尔回头跟李维打了声招呼，“比卧推赢现金和蛋白粉。”
李维看向迈克尔指的区域，果然看到了力量区中央被一群壮汉围住，一个体重超过110公斤、手臂比李维大腿还粗的黑人壮汉正在尝试使用160公斤的杠铃进行卧推。

“第一名多少钱？”李维看向迈克尔问道。
“500美金，外加1桶水解乳清蛋白，”迈克尔看向力量区，眼神充满艳羡，“他们真强壮啊，不知道不打药的情况下有没有可能达到他们的水平。”
“估计是有点难，”李维随口说道，“我上次看他们在交流打药的心得来着。”
“那算了，我想当医生，又不准备走体育路线......对了，”他想了想，指了指力量区靠前的一个年轻黑人，“你不是想加入富兰克林高中的橄榄球队吗？你看看他的身材，他就是球队的防守截锋，他马上上场了。”
李维的视线转了过去，看到了一个身高跟他差不多高，但是体重估计至少超过130公斤的大胖子正跃跃欲试，摩拳擦掌。
“14号选手，马努！”
富兰克林高中橄榄球队的马努欢呼一声，上台。
他长着一张完全不符合年龄的成熟恶脸，看上去像一只进化不完全的银背大猩猩。
听到裁判的示意声，他一边吼叫着一边让朋友拍击他的背部，一边走上了卧推架，试举165公斤。
“165公斤！开把成功！马努现在是第一名！”
content_en:
Placed on the sink was Don Quixote's somewhat dirty razor, with even burnt yellow scale and rust on the blade.
Obviously, people like Don Quixote who changed their long sleeves to short sleeves and short sleeves to underwear would not be willing to spend money to buy replacement blades.
But even a partially rusted blade can easily cut through a rough face, causing bleeding.
Levi took the razor, removed the blade, and then gently slid it on his arm.
A tough feeling came from the blade, as if what the blade scratched was not the human body, but something stronger than the blade, like a steel cable.
Levi scratched lightly at first, then he slightly increased the force, but he could still only make shallow white marks on his forearm.
However, Levi felt that this seemed to be the limit at the moment. As long as it was sharper and more powerful, it seemed that it could still cause a small amount of damage to him.
"But this seems to be only a bronze-level body," Levi suddenly remembered the mythological settings in the extracurricular readings he read, "Are there higher-level things like silver and gold bodies later?"
Just as he turned around, he accidentally knocked over the razor and toothbrush standing on the sink.
However, the moment he fell down, he reacted quickly and caught the razor and toothbrush that had just fallen off the sink one by one with one hand.
"Is this the agility of 1.4 and the spirit of 1.5?" Levi looked at the two things in his hands in surprise, "The agility suddenly increased by 0.2, and my nerve reaction speed also increased."
After putting the razor blade back on, Levi was already looking forward to the results he would get when he went to the gym tomorrow morning.
...
The Second Heaven Quixote woke up early as usual and went out with a heavy heart.
Levi made a slight change to his schedule today, moving his morning part-time job to the afternoon, and made an appointment with Michael to come to the gym to work out together today.
Around 10:15, when Levi had finished his homework and came to the gym, he was a little surprised to find that there were many more people in the gym than usual today. The front desk was empty, and Michael was crowded on the periphery and looking into the middle.
He stepped forward and tapped Michael on the shoulder.
"What's going on?" He pointed to the middle, "Why are there so many people today?"
"Oh... Levi, you're here, there is an event today," Michael turned around and greeted Levi, "You can win cash and protein powder by bench pressing."
Levi looked at the area that Michael pointed to, and sure enough he saw a group of strong men surrounded in the center of the strength area. A strong black man weighing more than 110 kilograms and with arms thicker than Levi's thighs was trying to bench press using a 160 kilogram barbell.
"How much does the first place cost?" Levi looked at Michael and asked.
"500 US dollars, plus a bucket of hydrolyzed whey protein," Michael looked at the strength area, his eyes full of envy, "They are so strong, I wonder if it is possible to reach their level without medication."
"It's probably a bit difficult," Levi said casually, "Last time I saw them exchanging their experiences on applying medicine."
"Forget it, I want to be a doctor, but I'm not going to take the sports route... By the way," he thought for a moment and pointed to a young black man in the front of the strength area, "Don't you want to join the football team of Franklin High School? Look at his figure, he is the defensive tackle of the team, and he will play right away."
Levi turned his eyes and saw a fat man about the same height as him, but estimated to weigh at least over 130 kilograms, eager to try and gear up.
"Contestant No. 14, Manu!"
Manu, of the Franklin High School football team, cheered and took the stage.
He has a mature and evil face that is completely inappropriate for his age.Like an incompletely evolved silverback gorilla.
Hearing the referee's signal, he roared and asked his friends to pat his back, then stepped onto the bench press rack and tried to lift 165 kilograms.
"165 kilograms! Successful start! Manu is now number one!"
